events.title: Henry VI Dies in the Tower of London
events.description: Henry VI, the last Lancastrian king of England, was killed in the Tower of London. The deed was ordered by his Yorkist rival, Edward IV, who had just regained the throne.
events.significance: His death effectively ended the Lancastrian claim to the crown during the Wars of the Roses and secured Edward IV's rule.

events.title: Clara Barton Founds the American Red Cross
events.description: Clara Barton, the Civil War nurse known as the 'Angel of the Battlefield', founded the American Red Cross. She built it into a national organization for disaster relief and aid.
events.significance: The organization grew into one of the country's best-known humanitarian groups. It has provided emergency relief and support to people in need for well over a century.

events.title: Lindbergh Lands in Paris
events.description: After about 33 hours in the air, Charles Lindbergh landed the Spirit of St. Louis at Le Bourget airfield near Paris. He completed the first solo nonstop flight across the Atlantic and was greeted by huge crowds.
events.significance: The flight made Lindbergh a global celebrity and boosted public confidence in air travel. It helped launch the age of commercial aviation.

events.title: Louis Slotin's Fatal Criticality Accident
events.description: At a Los Alamos laboratory, Manhattan Project physicist Louis Slotin was working with the plutonium core later nicknamed the 'demon core'. It went briefly critical and exposed him to a lethal dose of radiation.
events.significance: The accident was a sobering lesson in the dangers of nuclear research. It led to stricter safety procedures for handling fissile material.

events.title: Rajiv Gandhi Is Assassinated
events.description: Former Indian Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi was killed by a suicide bomber while campaigning in India. The attacker was linked to the Tamil Tigers, a Sri Lankan separatist group. At least 14 people died in the attack.
events.significance: The assassination shocked India and drew attention to the spillover of Sri Lanka's civil conflict. It also ended the life of one of the country's most prominent political leaders.
